findingsNew.title: Expansive review frontier requires and dispatches dimensions the configured reviewDimensions excluded
findingsNew.case: expansive review, reviewDimensions [correctness, security, maintainability]: node stays open with nextDimension traceability and the next iteration is dispatched to traceability although traceability_in_run is false
findingsNew.claim: Under depthMode expansive a review configured with a dimension subset still requires and dispatches every canonical dimension per frontier node, contradicting convergence.cjs and traceability_in_run.
findingsNew.counterevidenceSought: Reducer test deep-review-state-reducer.vitest.ts:1058 pins the four-dimension rule with a [correctness, security] config; spec.md and decision-record.md hold no rule on it.
findingsNew.alternativeExplanation: Four-dimension node universe may be intended; then convergence.cjs:1507 and traceability_in_run misstate the contract for expansive runs.
findingsNew.downgradeTrigger: A governing doc states an expansive node needs all canonical dimensions regardless of reviewDimensions and setup documents the widening.
